Container.Name: Printmich
Container.Overview: Printmich prints a photo of the day, week or month from your Immich library on a Canon imagePROGRAF PRO-310 or any other IPP Everywhere / AirPrint printer, with no driver. Pick photos from favorites, albums, people, tags, star ratings or "on this day", choose paper, size, borders, captions, color management and quality per preset, calibrate each Canon paper, and browse everything you've printed on a photo wall.[br][br]A read-only Immich API key is enough. Set the printer address in the web UI, or here as ipp://printer-ip/ipp/print. To discover printers automatically, put the container on br0 (or host) networking.
Container.Requires: An Immich server and a network printer that supports IPP Everywhere, such as the Canon imagePROGRAF PRO-310.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the Printmich web UI.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings database, print history previews, cached renders and uploaded ICC profiles.

Config.Name: Immich URL
Config.Description: Address of your Immich server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:2283. Leave empty to set it in the web UI.

Config.Name: Immich API key
Config.Description: An Immich API key. Read-only permissions are enough (see the README). Leave empty to set it in the web UI.

Config.Name: Printer address
Config.Description: IPP address of the printer, e.g. ipp://192.168.1.50/ipp/print or just its IP. Leave empty to choose it in the web UI.

Config.Name: Web UI password
Config.Description: Optional password for the web UI. Leave empty if Printmich is only reachable on your LAN or sits behind an authenticating proxy.

Config.Name: Immich address for links
Config.Description: Optional. The address your browser uses for Immich (e.g. https://photos.example.com), used for Open in Immich links.

Config.Name: Printmich public URL
Config.Description: Optional. The address you reach Printmich at, used for links in notifications.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as.
